Perfect! All 517 tests pass now. Here's a summary of the two bugs I found and fixed:

## Issues Found and Fixed

**1. formatMoney padding bug** (src/money.js:16)
   - Commit 958d3ae accidentally changed `padStart` to `padEnd`
   - This caused cents to pad on the right instead of left: `1 → "10"` instead of `"01"`
   - Fixed: Changed back to `padStart(2, "0")`

**2. Tax calculation bug** (src/invoice.js:22-23)
   - Commit 4188e9a broke discount handling when adding line-item discounts
   - Tax was computed on full subtotal instead of subtotal minus order-level discount
   - Test expected: `formatMoney(1) → "$0.01"` and tax on discounted amount
   - Fixed: Changed from `const taxable = subtotal` to computing tax on `subtotal - discount`
   - Also removed the unused `taxable` field from the return object

The changes preserved all the new features from those commits (thousands separators in formatMoney, line-item discounts support) while fixing the regressions.
